spans.s:
r. 6th cl. (रुशति)
To hurt or kill.
(इ) रुशि r. 10th cl. (रुंशयति)
To shine.

r. 1st cl. (रोषति) 4th cl. (रुष्यति)
To hurt, to injure, to kill or attempt to kill.
(इर्) रुषिर r. 4th and 10th cls. (रुष्यति रोषयति)
To be angry, to be passionate or wrathful.

r. 1st cl. (रूषति)
To decorate, to adorn.

mfn. (-शन्-शन्ती-शत्)
1 Maledictory, imprecative.
2 Cursing, imprecating.
E.
रुश to seek to injure, aff. शतृ.

f. (रुट्)
Anger, wrath, passion.
E.
रुष to be angry, aff. क्विप्; also with टाप् added रुषा f. (-षा)

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Enraged, angry.
E.
रुष to be angry, aff. क्त with इट् augment.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Pounded, reduced to dust or powder.
2 Covered, spread over, coated, inlaid.
3 Adorned, decorated.
4 Made rough or rugged.
E.
रूष to adorn, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Angry, enraged.
E.
रुष to be angry, aff. क्त.

f. (-ष्टिः)
Wrath, rage, anger.
E.
रुष to be angry, क्तिन् aff.

m. (-कः)
A plant, (Justicia ganderussa.)
E.
रूष to adorn, aff. क्वुन्.
